description: Build one cited digest of several videos (a playlist, a collection, or a list of URLs) using MCP sampling: the server asks the client's model to take notes on each part of each transcript, then combine them. Every claim cites [Title @ m:ss](link), and every timestamp is checked against the real transcript. No server key is needed. If this client cannot sample, the result is a chunk plan with the exact instructions, so you can do the same work yourself.

collection.description: A collection id or name; its saved videos are digested

maxTokensPerVideo.description: Most transcript tokens sent in one sampling call; longer videos are split by chapter or time. Default 6000

question.description: A question the digest should answer

urls.description: Video URLs, playlists or channels (expanded into their videos), saved video ids or titles

name: digest_videos
title: Digest videos with your own model
